To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) locally trained embeddings outperform global word embeddings for ad hoc IR tasks, (2) locally trained embeddings can be used to improve retrieval results by expanding the queries with terms related to the query terms, and (3) the best results are obtained when using a local embedding to expand the query and then re-rank the retrieved documents using a global embedding.
